definitions.CADENCE-ONLY: existing factorial 100: cadence enabled, added demand Guard and Recovery off, original JLC-Core and paid holds intact
definitions.NO-JOINT-PADC: same cadence/Guard/Recovery/holds; replace joint optimizer with causal PADC duty and nonbinding permission; disable joint-specific fallback and hybrid; physical battery, reserve, slots and paid admissions bind
definitions.SIMPLE-PADC-CADENCE: same cadence, PADC duty and nonbinding permission; no persistent holds, added Guard/Recovery off and original relay-repair off; common executor and paid admissions retained

caveats: PADC comparisons change multiple coupled design elements and are broad controls, not isolated causal effects
nojoint lacks the robust prefix-planning guarantee but does enforce physical per-transaction energy and reserve checks
all comparisons reuse parent 24 predefined seeds; secondary/exploratory, not added to parent primary Holm family
pilot: two development seeds, 2 days, synthetic supply 1; no performance selection
